words.note: 當 making a living 主要指透過工作、經營或其他合法方式獲得金錢收入時，可用 earn an income。它強調『有收入來源』，不一定表示收入足以完全獨立生活。
words.example: She earns an income by teaching online.
words.exampleZh: 她靠網上教學賺取收入。

exercises.original: He makes a living by repairing bicycles for local customers.
exercises.zh: 他靠為本地顧客維修單車賺取收入。
exercises.upgrade: earns an income · 賺取收入

options.explanation: earns an income = 賺取收入。by repairing bicycles 清楚指出收入來源，重點是透過工作取得金錢。
makes ends meet = 勉強維持收支平衡。重點是收入是否足夠支付開支，不等於『靠某工作賺收入』。
supports a family = 養家。可能是收入用途，但原句沒有說有家庭需要供養。
saves money = 儲錢。是收入之後可能做的事，不是賺取收入本身。
receives benefits = 領取福利。和靠維修工作賺錢不同。
lives cheaply = 節儉生活。描述消費方式，不是收入來源。

exercises.original: Many freelance designers make a living by working with clients in different countries.
exercises.zh: 很多自由工作設計師靠為不同國家的客戶工作賺取收入。
exercises.upgrade: earn an income · 賺取收入

options.explanation: support themselves only = 只養活自己。這會加入『收入足以獨立生活』的意思，原句只是說收入來源。
earn an income = 賺取收入。freelance work + clients 是典型收入來源語境。
make ends meet = 維持收支平衡。強調夠不夠用，不是怎樣取得收入。
save for retirement = 為退休儲蓄。是收入用途。
live on benefits = 靠福利生活。與 freelance client work 不符。
reduce expenses = 減少開支。不是賺錢。

exercises.original: She makes a living from selling handmade jewelry online.
exercises.zh: 她靠在網上出售手製首飾賺取收入。
exercises.upgrade: earns an income · 賺取收入

options.explanation: earns an income = 賺取收入。from selling handmade jewelry 明確指出商業收入來源。
cuts costs = 削減開支。不是收入。
lives independently = 獨立生活。可能由這份收入支持，但不是同一概念。
covers expenses = 支付開支。只是收入功能，不說收入如何取得。
receives support = 接受支援。和自己售貨賺錢相反。
works unpaid = 無薪工作。與 make a living 相反。

words.meaning: 在經濟上養活自己；自給自足
words.note: 強調收入足以支付自己的生活開支，不需要依靠父母、伴侶或其他人。比 earn an income 更明確包含『經濟獨立』。
words.example: After graduating, he was able to support himself financially.
words.exampleZh: 畢業後，他能夠在經濟上養活自己。

exercises.original: After finding full-time work, she could finally make a living without depending on her parents.
exercises.zh: 找到全職工作後，她終於能在經濟上養活自己，不必依靠父母。
exercises.upgrade: support herself financially · 在經濟上養活自己；自給自足

options.explanation: earn an income = 賺取收入。可能有收入但仍不足以獨立生活；題目特別說不再依靠父母。
support herself financially = 在經濟上養活自己。without depending on her parents 是決定性線索。
make ends meet barely = 勉強收支平衡。加入『勉強』意味，原句沒有。
save aggressively = 大量儲蓄。不是自給自足本身。
receive assistance = 接受援助。與不依靠父母的方向相反。
work part-time = 做兼職。工作形式不代表能否經濟獨立。

exercises.original: He wants to make a living on his own before moving out of the family home.
exercises.zh: 他想在搬離家庭住所前先做到經濟上養活自己。
exercises.upgrade: support himself financially · 在經濟上養活自己；自給自足

options.explanation: make ends meet temporarily = 暫時勉強維持收支。語氣加入困難和短期意味。
support himself financially = 經濟上養活自己。before moving out 表示他希望先具備獨立生活能力。
receive family support = 接受家庭支援。和獨立目標相反。
earn pocket money = 賺零用錢。通常不足以養活自己。
cut household bills = 減低家庭開支。不是收入能力。
save occasionally = 偶爾儲蓄。和經濟獨立不同。

exercises.original: The training program helps young adults make a living without relying on long-term financial help from relatives.
exercises.zh: 這個培訓計劃幫助年輕成年人在不長期依賴親屬經濟支援的情況下養活自己。
exercises.upgrade: support themselves financially · 在經濟上養活自己；自給自足

options.explanation: support themselves financially = 在經濟上養活自己。without relying on relatives 清楚是經濟獨立。
earn spending money = 賺零用錢。金額未必足夠生活。
reduce taxes = 減稅。不是養活自己。
live cheaply = 節省生活。可能有幫助，但不是收入獨立。
borrow regularly = 經常借錢。反而顯示未能自給自足。
receive allowances = 收取津貼。也是依賴外來支援。

words.note: 較正式，幾乎直接等於 make a living。常見於報告、新聞和較書面的描述，強調某項工作或活動是維持生活的收入來源。
words.example: Many families earn a livelihood from fishing.

exercises.original: For generations, families in the village have made a living from fishing.
exercises.zh: 數代以來，村裡的家庭一直靠捕魚維生。
exercises.upgrade: earned a livelihood · 謀生；賺取生計

options.explanation: earned a livelihood = 謀生。for generations + from fishing 表示捕魚是長期主要生計來源。
made ends meet occasionally = 偶爾維持收支。不能表達捕魚是主要生計。
received aid = 接受援助。不是靠捕魚賺錢。
saved money = 儲蓄。不是收入來源。
reduced costs = 減低成本。無關。
worked for free = 無薪工作。和維生相反。

exercises.original: The craft market allows local artists to make a living from their work.
exercises.zh: 這個手工藝市場讓本地藝術家靠自己的作品維生。
exercises.upgrade: earn a livelihood · 謀生；賺取生計

options.explanation: support a charity = 支持慈善機構。不是藝術家自己的生計。
earn a livelihood = 賺取生計。from their work 清楚表示靠作品維持生活。
receive grants only = 只領資助。題目說的是市場銷售帶來的收入。
make ends meet by borrowing = 靠借錢勉強生活。完全不同。
lower expenses = 減低開支。不是謀生方式。
volunteer = 做義工。通常無薪。

exercises.original: Many people in the region make a living through farming and small-scale trade.
exercises.zh: 該地區很多人靠農耕和小規模貿易維生。
exercises.upgrade: earn a livelihood · 謀生；賺取生計

options.explanation: earn a livelihood = 謀生。farming and trade 是典型正式描述生計來源的語境。
save for retirement = 為退休儲蓄。不是現時生計。
receive welfare = 領福利。不是靠農耕和貿易。
share expenses = 分擔開支。不是收入來源。
avoid debt = 避免負債。是財務結果。
work casually = 做散工。未必足以維生，且沒有保留原句來源。

words.note: 和 make a living 非常接近，是自然、傳統的表達。常用 earn one's living by/from... 指明靠甚麼工作維生。
words.example: He earns his living as a carpenter.

exercises.original: She makes a living as a translator.
exercises.zh: 她以翻譯工作謀生。
exercises.upgrade: earns her living · 謀生；靠工作維持生活

options.explanation: earns her living = 謀生。as a translator 是職業身份，和 earn one's living as... 是自然搭配。
supports a household = 支持家庭開支。原句沒有家庭資訊。
makes ends meet = 收支平衡。不是職業來源表達。
receives an allowance = 收津貼。不是工作收入。
saves steadily = 穩定儲蓄。不是謀生。
lives simply = 簡樸生活。無關。

exercises.original: He makes a living by driving a taxi at night.
exercises.zh: 他靠夜間駕駛的士謀生。
exercises.upgrade: earns his living · 謀生；靠工作維持生活

options.explanation: makes ends meet = 維持收支。不能自然接 by driving... 表示主要職業來源。
earns his living = 謀生。by driving a taxi 清楚指出怎樣賺取生活所需收入。
supports others = 供養他人。原句沒有。
lives frugally = 節儉生活。不是賺錢。
receives benefits = 收福利。和工作收入不符。
works occasionally = 偶爾工作。不能保證是生計。

exercises.original: For most of his adult life, he made a living from repairing musical instruments.
exercises.zh: 成年後大部分時間，他都靠維修樂器謀生。
exercises.upgrade: earned his living · 謀生；靠工作維持生活

options.explanation: earned his living = 靠……謀生。for most of his adult life + from repairing instruments 表示長期職業收入來源。
borrowed money = 借錢。不是工作謀生。
reduced spending = 減少支出。不是收入。
received family support = 接受家庭支援。和靠工作維生不同。
saved part-time = 搭配不自然，也不是謀生。
worked unpaid = 無薪工作。相反。

words.meaning: 靠工作維生；工作賺錢過生活
words.note: 較口語，強調一個人需要工作來支付生活開支。常用來和 hobby、volunteering、wealth 等情況作對比。
words.example: Most people work for a living rather than for entertainment.
words.exampleZh: 大多數人工作是為了維生，而不是娛樂。

exercises.original: He paints because he makes a living from it, not because it is simply a weekend hobby.
exercises.zh: 他畫畫是靠這份工作維生，不只是週末興趣。
exercises.upgrade: works for a living · 靠工作維生；工作賺錢過生活

options.explanation: works for a living = 靠工作維生。not simply a hobby 明確對比工作收入和興趣。
paints for fun = 為興趣畫畫。和原句相反。
volunteers = 做義工。通常無薪。
lives on savings = 靠積蓄生活。不是工作收入。
receives support = 接受支援。不是靠自己工作。
works occasionally = 偶爾工作。未必足以維生。

exercises.original: Unlike the volunteers, the staff members make a living from the work they do here.
exercises.zh: 和義工不同，員工靠在這裡的工作維生。
exercises.upgrade: work for a living · 靠工作維生；工作賺錢過生活

options.explanation: work for a living = 靠工作維生。unlike the volunteers 是決定性線索，表示這些人工作是收入來源。
save for a living = 搭配不自然。save 不是這個意思。
work for free = 無薪工作。和 staff members earning a living 相反。
receive charity = 接受慈善援助。不是工作收入。
reduce expenses = 減支。無關。
depend on relatives = 依賴親屬。和靠工作維生不同。

exercises.original: She enjoys writing, but she also makes a living from it and depends on the income to pay her bills.
exercises.zh: 她喜歡寫作，但也靠寫作維生，並依賴這筆收入支付帳單。
exercises.upgrade: works for a living · 靠工作維生；工作賺錢過生活

options.explanation: works for a living = 靠工作維生。depends on the income to pay bills 表示工作具有實際生計功能。
writes only for pleasure = 只為興趣寫作。和 depends on the income 相反。
lives on family money = 靠家人金錢生活。原句說靠寫作收入。
works unpaid = 無薪工作。相反。
earns pocket money = 賺零用錢。力度太弱。
reduces bills = 減少帳單。不是收入來源。

words.meaning: 能自給自足；經濟上自立
words.note: 強調一個人有足夠收入支付自己的生活，不依賴他人供養。較正式，也常用於教育、家庭或社會政策語境。
words.example: By age twenty-three, she was fully self-supporting.
words.exampleZh: 到二十三歲時，她已能完全自給自足。

exercises.original: By the end of the program, participants should be able to make a living without regular financial help from others.
exercises.zh: 課程結束時，參加者應能在不接受他人定期經濟援助下自給自足。
exercises.upgrade: be self-supporting · 能自給自足；經濟上自立

options.explanation: be self-supporting = 能自給自足。without regular financial help from others 明確是經濟自立。
make ends meet with loans = 靠借貸維持收支。仍然依賴外部資金。
receive allowances = 收津貼。不是自給自足。
live cheaply = 節省生活。可能幫助自立，但不等於有足夠收入。
depend on family = 依賴家庭。相反。
work unpaid = 無薪工作。不能直接支持生活。

exercises.original: She became able to make a living on her own after her small business became profitable.
exercises.zh: 她的小生意開始盈利後，她便能夠經濟自立。
exercises.upgrade: be self-supporting · 能自給自足；經濟上自立

options.explanation: earn pocket money = 賺零用錢。通常不足以支付全部生活開支。
be self-supporting = 經濟自立。business became profitable + on her own 清楚表示能靠自己生活。
receive support = 接受支援。方向相反。
share expenses only = 只分擔開支。不一定能獨立生活。
reduce spending = 減少支出。不是收入自立。
borrow regularly = 經常借錢。表示仍未完全自給自足。

exercises.original: The goal is to help residents make a living independently rather than rely on long-term subsidies.
exercises.zh: 目標是幫助居民經濟自立，而不是長期依賴補貼。
exercises.upgrade: be self-supporting · 能自給自足；經濟上自立

options.explanation: be self-supporting = 自給自足。rather than rely on subsidies 是決定性對比。
live on subsidies = 靠補貼生活。正是句子要避免的情況。
work occasionally = 偶爾工作。未必足以自立。
spend less = 少花錢。只是支出策略。
share bills = 分擔帳單。仍可能依賴他人。
receive grants = 收資助。也是外部支援。

words.meaning: 養活自己；供應自己的生活所需
words.note: 表示自己負擔生活所需，包括食物、住屋和基本開支。比 earn an income 更強調『收入足以供自己生活』，語氣略正式。
words.example: He learned a trade so he could provide for himself.
words.exampleZh: 他學了一門手藝，好讓自己能養活自己。

exercises.original: She took the job because she wanted to make a living without depending on her relatives.
exercises.zh: 她接受這份工作，因為她想靠自己養活自己，不依賴親屬。
exercises.upgrade: provide for herself · 養活自己；供應自己的生活所需

options.explanation: provide for herself = 養活自己。without depending on relatives 表示自己負擔生活需要。
earn spending money = 賺零用錢。未必足夠生活。
receive support = 接受支援。相反。
make ends meet by borrowing = 靠借貸維持。仍是依賴外部資源。
live cheaply = 節儉。不是收入自立。
save occasionally = 偶爾儲蓄。無關。

exercises.original: He learned carpentry so that he could make a living for himself after leaving school.
exercises.zh: 他學木工，好讓自己離校後能養活自己。
exercises.upgrade: provide for himself · 養活自己；供應自己的生活所需

options.explanation: earn a little money = 賺一點錢。a little 不一定足以生活。
provide for himself = 養活自己。learned carpentry + after leaving school 表示取得能支持生活的技能。
depend on family = 依賴家庭。相反。
work for free = 無薪工作。不能養活自己。
reduce rent = 降低租金。不是收入來源。
receive an allowance = 收零用／津貼。不是靠自己供養。

exercises.original: The apprenticeship gave her the skills she needed to make a living independently.
exercises.zh: 這項學徒訓練讓她獲得能獨立養活自己的技能。
exercises.upgrade: provide for herself · 養活自己；供應自己的生活所需

options.explanation: provide for herself = 養活自己。skills + independently 指向靠自己的能力負擔生活。
live on benefits = 靠福利生活。不是技能帶來的獨立。
borrow from friends = 向朋友借錢。不是自立。
share costs = 分擔開支。未必代表經濟獨立。
save on food = 節省食物開支。太窄。
work occasionally = 偶爾工作。未必足以維生。

falseSynonyms.zh: 維持收支平衡；勉強應付開支不等於一般的 making a living make ends meet = 維持收支平衡；勉強應付開支 make ends meet 強調收入是否足以支付生活開支，常帶『剛剛夠用』的意味；making a living 則重點是透過工作或收入來源維生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can make a living from a job but still struggle to make ends meet.

falseSynonyms.zh: 賺錢不等於一般的 making a living earn money = 賺錢 earn money 只表示取得金錢，不保證這筆收入足以維持生活，因此比 making a living 範圍更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A teenager may earn money without making a living.

falseSynonyms.zh: 養家不等於一般的 making a living support a family = 養家 support a family 表示負擔家人的生活開支；making a living 可以只指養活自己。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Someone may make a living without supporting dependents.

falseSynonyms.zh: 靠……生活不等於一般的 making a living live on = 靠……生活 live on 通常需要接收入來源，例如 live on savings / benefits / a pension。它描述依靠甚麼生活，不一定表示自己賺取收入。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She lives on a pension, but she no longer earns a living.

falseSynonyms.zh: 賺錢；獲利不等於一般的 making a living make money = 賺錢；獲利 make money 可表示賺取任何金額或獲利，甚至只是副業收入；making a living 通常表示足以支撐生活的主要收入來源。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A hobby can make money without providing a full living.

falseSynonyms.zh: 經濟獨立不等於一般的 making a living financial independence = 經濟獨立 financial independence 是一種財務狀態；making a living 是取得生活收入的行為或方式。兩者相關但不相同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Making a living may lead to financial independence.

falseSynonyms.zh: 生計；謀生手段不等於一般的 making a living livelihood = 生計；謀生手段 livelihood 是名詞，指維持生活的收入來源或方式；making a living 是動名詞片語，語法位置不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Fishing is their livelihood. They make a living from fishing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 足以維持基本生活的工資不等於一般的 making a living living wage = 足以維持基本生活的工資 living wage 是一種工資標準，指足以支付基本生活所需的薪酬，不等於 making a living 這個行為。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A living wage is a pay level; making a living is earning enough to live.

falseSynonyms.zh: Target word: Earn An Income · 賺取收入 他靠為本地顧客維修單車賺取收入。 earns an income · 賺取收入 earns an income = 賺取收入。by repairing bicycles 清楚指出收入來源，重點是透過工作取得金錢。 makes ends meet =
